mapper.insert: insert into clazz (name, room,master_id, begin_date, end_date,update_time, subject) values (#{name}, #{room}, #{masterId}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{updateTime}, #{subject})
mapper.update: update clazz set name = #{name}, room = #{room}, master_id = #{masterId}, begin_date = #{beginDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, update_time = #{updateTime}, subject = #{subject} where id = #{id}
